thread:
Elena (PM): dropping a new compact-layout mock for the Usage page. three open questions: where the token breakdown lives, behavior of the Account vs Team scope switch, and invoice/download placement. figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (compact grid v1)
Maya (Design): proposal: move token legend out of the sparkline cell and into a dedicated right-column slot. on <720px collapse to a small icon that opens a popover with the legend. keeps rows tidy. :sparkles:
Ben (Frontend): popover legend is simpler for responsive. prefer a tiny trigger button with aria-expanded and keyboard support. avoids forcing horizontal scroll.
Aldo (Data): important: billing series order. finance expects compute, embeddings, storage. current stack is ingestion order. suggest backend return prioritized series order and include stable keys in the payload.
Sasha (Eng): we can implement prioritized ordering server-side and add a "series_priority" field. frontend then renders as-is. also flag: the tooltip currently queries a heavy realtime endpoint for cache-hit. recommend switching to pre-aggregated telemetry and marking it "estimated".
Maya (Design): copy tweak for scope switch: replace "Account / Workspace" with "Account / Team" to match other surfaces. also banner idea for team-lag: small inline notice: "Team metrics update ~10 min" with info tooltip linking docs.
Elena (PM): agree on inline banner vs modal. make banner subtle and non-blocking.
a11y-bot: color contrast alert: small legend labels fall below 4.5:1. suggest darker text or patterns for the stacked areas.
Ben (Frontend): implement an accessibility toggle for patterned fills and increase label weight. CSS perf should be OK if patterns are optional.
Aldo (Data): export request: customers want a daily ledger CSV: columns = date, project_id (if team scoped), token_type, model, tokens, cost_usd, invoice_id (when applicable). add an Export button in chart header.
Maya (Design): on invoices: global "Download Invoice" button is fine for account-level billing. per-row "Download Receipt" only when invoice_exists=true. reduces clutter.
Ben (Frontend): per-row buttons can be virtualized; render on demand to keep DOM light. will add lazy hydration.
Sasha (Eng): note for release: change to pre-agg telemetry for tooltip, update API for series order, and add CSV endpoint. coordinate infra tickets.
Elena (PM): action items: Maya update figma with right-column legend + compact icon variant; Aldo post CSV API spec; Ben prototype popover + banner; Sasha prep telemetry swap. schedule brief design review next Thu.
Maya (Design): will push v2 and tag here.
Ben (Frontend): branch started, will link PR when ready.
Aldo (Data): CSV spec to #design-docs today.
Elena (PM): thanks all, nice progress.
